about.zh: 证明板：规则即元件，从已知接到目标
about.en: the proof board: rules as parts, wired from the givens to the goal
a truth table, filled in row by row

about.zh: 真值电路：一块门电路在真值表的每一行上跑
about.en: a truth circuit: a board of gates run on every row of a truth table

about.zh: 规则板：声明一个连接词的引入规则，或用条例检验别人的声明
about.en: the rule board: a connective’s introduction rules declared, or someone’s declaration checked by cases

about.zh: 定义：给每一行选一个右边
about.en: a definition: a right side picked for every row

about.zh: 翻译：把一句话拼成公式
about.en: translating: a sentence built as a formula

about.zh: 查询：拼一句带 x 的话，在每个世界里选中答案
about.en: a query: a sentence with x that picks out the answers in every world

about.zh: 造世界：让句子真假如所要
about.en: building a world in which the sentences come out as asked

about.zh: 证明助手：机器板上的一块电路，处理每组测试的输入
about.en: a proof assistant: a machine board run on every test’s input

about.zh: 写脚本：一行一句，by 后面是证法
about.en: writing a script: a row a statement, each with its by
